title: Bounded-size generators for acyclic complexes
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian]. For an object $M$ of $\mathcal A$ its *size* $|M|$ is the cardinality of the set of subobjects of $M$. There exists a cardinal $\kappa$ such that for every acyclic (as in [def-pc-acyclic-complex-modules] with $\mathcal A$ in place of $\Mod(\mathcal O)$) cochain complex $M^\bullet$ in $\mathcal A$ (cochain complexes defined as in [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] with $\mathcal A$ in place of $\Mod(\mathcal O)$): (1) if $M^\bullet\neq0$, there is a nonzero subcomplex $N^\bullet\subset M^\bullet$ which is bounded above, acyclic, and has $|N^n|\le\kappa$ for all $n$; (2) there is a surjection of complexes $\bigoplus_{i\in I}M_i^\bullet\to M^\bullet$ with each $M_i^\bullet$ bounded above, acyclic, and $|M_i^n|\le\kappa$ for all $n$.

mathlib_searches.query: existence of a cardinal kappa such that every nonzero acyclic complex has a nonzero bounded-above acyclic subcomplex of terms of size at most kappa
mathlib_searches.results: HomologicalComplex truncation and acyclicity declarations; no bounded-size generator theorem
